pages.text: The Interface in Refined Storage 2 is a versatile block that combines the functionalities of both the $(l:importer)Importer$() and the $(l:exporter)Exporter$() with enhanced performance and reliability. It serves as a bridge between your Refined Storage network and external inventories, allowing for both importing and exporting of items and fluids with improved efficiency.$(br2)Importing$(br)Unlike the Importer, the Interface has an internal inventory that can receive items directly through pipes, hoppers, or other means. This internal inventory is accessible via the GUI under 'Interface Import'. Note that the Interface does not automatically extract items from adjacent inventories; they must be inserted manually. RS2 features improved inventory handling and better mod compatibility.$(br2)Exporting$(br)The Interface can also export items from the system, which can be piped out using external mods, hoppers, etc. It supports NBT and damage-sensitive configurations with enhanced precision. To configure output, click an item in the export slots and adjust the amount with left or right clicks. Use shift to clear the slot. RS2 includes improved export control and better performance for large quantities.
